titleZh: 三奖加冕：AuroArc、CactyCalma 与柔性植物 PDRN 技术
titleEn: Three awards: AuroArc, CactyCalma and flexible botanical PDRN
summaryZh: 从 300 余款参赛原料中，两款原料摘得「年度好原料」，一项技术获「年度好技术」。三座奖杯说的是同一件事：一款原料被配方师看见，一项技术被产业看见。
summaryEn: From more than 300 entries, two ingredients took Ingredient of the Year and one technology took Technology of the Year. Three trophies say one thing: an ingredient seen by formulators, a technology seen by the industry.
